page: Microsoft Azure L48as_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Lasv5 family, hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is configured with an x86_64 AMD processor architecture providing 48 dedicated vCPUs. Memory capacity totals 384.0 GB of RAM, establishing a ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are omitted, with zero GPUs present.

A central hardware feature is the bundled local storage subsystem, which delivers 11519 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. The instance also supports Azure Premium Storage for external managed disk attachments. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided with the instance provisioning.

In terms of resource density, bundling over 11.5 TB of local NVMe storage directly with 384 GB of RAM reduces reliance on network-attached storage tiers for high-throughput I/O operations. A primary architectural tradeoff is that local NVMe storage volumes are typically ephemeral, requiring application-level redundancy or secondary persistent volume integration to safeguard data across host lifecycle events.

Microsoft Azure L48as_v5 is targeted at I/O-intensive workloads requiring extensive memory and direct NVMe capacity. Relevant deployments include large distributed NoSQL data stores, transactional relational database management systems, data warehousing, big data processing engines, and high-volume indexing clusters.
description: Microsoft Azure L48as_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine within the Lasv5 series, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. Driven by an x86_64 AMD processor, the instance supplies 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The configuration integrates 11519 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, delivering high local disk capacity and low-latency storage access. The server features no GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By consolidating dense memory and high-capacity local flash storage onto a single 48-core system, it eliminates network storage bottlenecks for high-throughput operations, balanced against the need for data replication to manage ephemeral disk characteristics. The L48as_v5 is designed for I/O-intensive applications such as transactional database engines, distributed NoSQL databases, search indexing systems, and large-scale data analytics.
